script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" \
  --json '{"role":"qa-invalid","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_BADROLE"}]}' --expect 422 \
  --check detail.0.loc contains role --save F06.send-validation/role
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json '{"content":"QA_F06_PLAIN"}' --expect 422 \
  --check detail.0.loc contains content
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" \
  --json '{"content":[{"type":"qa-unknown","text":"QA_F06_BADTYPE"}]}' --expect 422
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains body
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq 5
